questions.question: Every ability of Guts
questions.subject: Guts
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14, per-character abilities batch. `closed` -- the Abilities section is a bounded named list of five. The page documents Guts' abilities separately from his equipment: berserk-set-01 covers the armor and berserk-set-02 covers the weapons, so the Equipment subsections (Dragon Slayer, Berserker Armor, Cannon Arm, Repeater Crossbow, Throwing Knives, Miniature Bombs) are deliberately left out here. Golden Age through Fantasia arcs only; nothing from the continuation era published after Miura's death.

questions.question: Every ability of Griffith
questions.subject: Griffith
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14, per-character abilities batch. `closed` -- the Abilities section names exactly these twelve. Spans human Griffith (Golden Age) and Femto (Millennium Falcon and Fantasia arcs), and every ability is established within those arcs, so nothing runs past Miura's run. The Femto abilities (Morality Transcendence, Nigh-Absoluteness, Causal Awareness, Spatial Manipulation, Intangibility, Flight, Communing) are documented on this same page. Equipment is excluded: the page's armors carry a hatnote that their names are conjectural and unestablished, and the sabre has no named variant. Charisma, Beauty and Leadership and Tactics are included because the wiki names them as ability headings.

questions.question: Every ability of Puck
questions.subject: Puck
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14, per-character abilities batch. `closed` -- the page's Abilities section names exactly four species traits. All four are established by the Black Swordsman arc and used throughout, with nothing drawn from the continuation era. Elf Dust and Puck Spark are the wiki's own names, not invented entries.

questions.question: Every ability of Serpico
questions.subject: Serpico
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14, per-character abilities batch. `closed` -- the page documents Serpico's abilities through named equipment rather than a named ability list: the Physical Abilities and Tactical Abilities headings are prose with no bolded ability names, so the named entries are the Rapier, Sylph Sword and Sylph Cloak. The Sylph Cloak grants flight and superhuman jumps, and the Sylph Sword cuts with air currents, so the equipment is the ability here. Conviction through Millennium Falcon arcs (the sylph gear comes from Flora); nothing from the continuation era.
